acceptance: an element passes when its absolute or relative error is inside tolerance; the whole-tensor cosine difference (combined-norm form, accumulated over row chunks) must also stay inside its limit; positions of +inf, -inf and NaN must match the reference exactly and any NaN (an unwritten element included) fails; scored cases, the native edge cases (two calls each) and the sanitizer subset use the same rule, except that a numeric failure under memcheck defers the case's verdict to its native run

memory_safety.sanitizer: compute-sanitizer --tool memcheck --padding 4194304 --destroy-on-device-error context, torch/cuBLAS kernels excluded by name, PYTORCH_NO_CUDA_MEMORY_CACHING=1, plain allocations, one process, one call per sanitize case, stop at the first fatal CUDA error; only invalid __global__/__shared__/__local__ or misaligned reports fail

special_values: positions of +inf, -inf and NaN must match the reference exactly; any NaN fails

lse.abs_scaling: abs limit multiplied by max(1, sm_scale / 0.5); upstream calibrated 1e-6 only at sm_scale 0.5

max_logits.abs_scaling: abs limit multiplied by max(1, sm_scale / 0.5); upstream calibrated 1e-6 only at sm_scale 0.5
